main_text.p: Duodecim difyllabæ, ἀμφὶ circa, ἀνὰ per, ἀπὸ p, ἀπὸ ab, ὀπὶ ob,in: ὑπὸ super, ὑπὸ sub, μετὰ trans, cum: διὰ per, κατὰ contra, παρὰ apud, περὶ de. ἀμφὶ, Æolicé ἀμπὶ, circa: hic α & ι finales corripiuntur.
Præpositio compofita verbo per vocalé aspiratam incipienti, nō solúm vocalem tollit, sed etiam τ & ϖ mutat in θ & φ, ut κατὰ ἀπτω annecto, ἀφαιρέω aufero, ex κατὰ & ἁπλῶ, ἀπὸ & ἀφαιρέω.
main_text.head: Cap. 42. De conjunctione.
main_text.p: Conjunctio copulativa, ut ὑ & τε que.
Connexiva, ut ἐάν, εἰ, si, (Doricé αἰ, unde αἶκα pro εἴκε si fòrté) εἴαρ, εἰδὲ, εἰδήπερ, siquidem.
Discretiva, ut μέν quidem, δὲ vero, ὅμως tamen, ἀλλὰ sed, γοῦν quippe, γε quidem.

page.notes: Greek and polytonic forms are approximate; several Greek words are only partly legible in the scan, and the lower marks (t, ÿ) are ink marks, not text. Ink stains on the page were not transcribed.
